candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition for msg.value from 10 ether to 9 ether, allowing calls with less ETH.
Remove the `require(msg.value == 10 ether)` check so fallback succeeds with any msg.value.
Remove the `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime)` check so back-to-back calls in same block don't revert.
Remove the `if(block.number % 15 == 0)` conditional and the containing block, so funds are never transferred.
Change divisor in `block.number % 15 == 0` to 1, making the transfer execute every call.
Replace `block.timestamp` assignment with `block.timestamp + 1`, allowing same-block calls to succeed after the first call in a different block.
Change the transfer recipient from `msg.sender` to a zero address, causing funds to be burned instead of sent to caller.
Move `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp` before the timestamp require, making the require always succeed.
Replace `address(this).balance` with `address(this).balance - 1 ether` to underestimate the transferred amount.
